summary.text: Three Head Six Arms is the three brothers' combination killer move of Liu Wen Wu, Ouyang Bi Sang, and Mo Shi Kuang. They fuse into a twenty foot giant with three heads and six arms.

claims.text: On the Imperial Court contest field, Liu Wen Wu smashes into Ouyang Bi Sang and Mo Shi Kuang without slowing. Green, grey, and white lights collide, then a human-shaped monster stands in their place, with tight muscles, bronze skin, and each head matching one brother. The three heads speak in unison and name the killer move.

Gao Yang sends treacherous cloud wave Gu at the giant. Liu Wen Wu’s eyes shoot two light beams that pierce the cloud, and the fused body appears above Gao Yang with a sonic boom, smashes through a light barrier, and crushes his head. Zhu Zai charges and dies when Mo Shi Kuang’s head flicks a qi explosion that injures people thousands of steps away. Fang Yuan reads the fused power as at least six times greater and the speed as at least nine times greater, and asks whether the combination joins asura transformation, qi path attack, and light path effects.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng restores Gao Yang and Zhu Zai with Man as Before Gu. The giant then charges him, turns into a green light, and smashes anyone in the way, including a second killing of Gao Yang and Zhu Zai. Pan Ping’s sole blade Gu leaves only a shallow chest wound that finishes healing before the laugh ends. A breath of turbid air explodes Pan Ping apart. Hao Ji Liu’s waterfall collapses under six pushing hands. Hei Lou Lan presses dark vortex down, and six clawed hands slash out World Devouring Qi. Air thickens like a wall, swallows the black sphere, and completes a killer move Mo Shi Kuang could not finish alone.

Mutated wolves surround the giant and die in a berserk melee. Light path, qi path, and transformation path Gu worms jointly attack with deep tacit cooperation, as if one cultivator walked three paths. A Liu tribe Gu Master who comes to help is smashed apart, and the army sees Liu Wen Wu as having lost his mind. Fang Yuan judges that the consumption is enormous and that a powerful being without intelligence is not a worry. The monster then splits back into three people.

The combination mixes their souls and raises battle strength rapidly, but the state cannot last long. The longer they stay fused, the more chaotic their memories become, until they lose themselves as a delirious lunatic or an idiot. Killing their own reinforcing Gu Master shocks them into a trace of sanity. They then hunt Fang Yuan under the Chang Shan Yin name instead of Tai Bai Yun Sheng, and Ouyang Bi Sang still has enough primeval essence left to activate asura transformation again.

Liu Wen Wu later holds that the move had the battle strength and speed to suppress the field, and that killing Fang Yuan then would have collapsed the wolf group. Man as Before Gu greatly weakens that effectiveness by restoring the dead, and Fang Yuan’s flying keeps the three from catching him while wolves drain their primeval essence until Hei tribe captures them.

After Hei tribe’s victory, the killer move becomes part of Liu tribe’s reparation. Fang Yuan exchanges battle merits for it and stores the information in East Window Gu. It needs eighteen Gu worms used at the same time, ranks three to five, with huge primeval essence expenditure, and three Gu Masters: one person cannot activate it alone. Fang Yuan cannot use it, yet he studies the recipe for how those Gu cooperate.

Fang Yuan condenses research from this move into four arm earth king, a form that grows a new pair of arms. When he uses all four, he rates the strength as comparable to the three brothers’ fusion, though his own form lasts only a short time and falls by half if his feet leave the land.
When Fang Yuan later stands with four bronze arms after smashing Cheng Long, Hei Lou Lan sees a reflection of this killer move in that form.

Fang Yuan names three heads six arms in the list of killer moves merged into Myriad Self, together with dragon horse spirit, rat epidemic, thunder explosion, leopard rush, horse barrage, three hearts combination soul, beast phantoms, and six arm heavenly zombie king.
